objective: L_forecast + mean_valid ||a_k(state_t) - psi(Y_tk)||^2 / 10; default auxiliary weight 1, no marginal Gaussian regularizer
target: Y_tk=(logclose(t+h)-logclose(t)-beta_t*(marketcum(t+h)-marketcum(t)))/(sigma_t*sqrt(h)); only source-causal statistics, no learned target encoder or fitted normalization
predictor: existing D512 -> 256 GELU -> 50 direct outputs at same eligible source positions; forecasting trunk/head unchanged
mask: valid full source patch, source minimum history, and every bar from t+1 through t+h; no time pooling as population
population_reasoning: The optimum is E[psi(Y)|history]. Irreducible future variability is fixed by data, cannot be shrunk by an encoder. Independent future noise cannot improve expected skill against the marginal-mean baseline; predictable nuisance helps only if it predicts the declared outcome features. Finite frequencies identify these conditional moments, not the full conditional distribution.
risks: Predictable volatility can improve characteristic-feature skill without improving point accuracy
Finite-sample spurious associations and optimizer interference remain
The auxiliary overlaps existing forecasting supervision; improvement is not guaranteed
This is task-anchored temporal self-supervision, not a claim of target-agnostic LeJEPA equivalence
evaluation: Reuse identical authenticated actual-forecast panels against both original forecast recipes, all original JEPA arms and projected placement pair. Primary predefined aggregate close MSE/persistence over 1,8,16,32,64,128,192 bars; report direction, signed IC, per-horizon error and calibration tradeoffs. Auxiliary skill against frozen train-only marginal mean and zero-return features is diagnostic, never selection criterion.
stopping: exact fixed endpoint, one normal-priority exclusive job per model; watchdog is failure bound, no latent-loss selection or multiple-seed sweep
